title: Binance Will List Spell Token (SPELL) and TerraUSD (UST)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list  Spell Token (SPELL)  and  TerraUSD (UST)  and will open trading for  SPELL/BTC ,  SPELL/BUSD ,  SPELL/USDT ,  UST/BTC ,  UST/BUSD , and  UST/USDT  trading pairs at 2021-12-24 08:00 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  SPELL  and  UST  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for SPELL and UST will open at 2021-12-25 08:00 (UTC) Note: Binance will only support SPELL Avalanche C-Chain and ERC-20 token deposits and withdrawals The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page What is Spell Token (SPELL)? Abracadabra is a multichain lending protocol that utilizes interest-bearing tokens as collateral to mint a USD pegged stablecoin - Magic Internet Money (MIM). SPELL is its governance token that can be staked to receive protocol’s revenue. What is TerraUSD (UST)? TerraUSD (UST) is a decentralized algorithmic stablecoin of the Terra blockchain. In order to mint 1 TerraUSD, 1 USD worth of the reserve asset, LUNA, must be burned. SPELL and UST Listing Fee: 0 BNB.
